messages:
Anya (People Ops): Quick Q — booked a 4-person Eurail pass + local e-scooter weekly subscriptions and a 3-night hostel for the offsite. Company card was declined on Eurail checkout so I used personal card. How should we submit and split? Also was charged a host service fee on booking — reimbursable?
Sam (Travel Ops): Sorry about the decline — we had a temporary vendor block in EU last night. For the Eurail: submit the full personal receipt and indicate teammates split in the expense form. Use the 'group expense' checkbox and list each person on the itemization. Attach proof (card decline screenshot) if you have it. :thumbsup:
Diego: For the e-scooter subscriptions I can cover my share if needed — are subscriptions eligible? It's recurrent.
Jenna: We typically reimburse short-term mobility passes (<=30 days) if work-related. Put it under 'Ground transport' and mark dates.
Sam (Travel Ops): Host service fees for hostels: reimbursable if it's part of the mandatory booking fee (service/tax). If it's an optional add-on (like insurance or premium placement) People Ops will review case-by-case. Please upload itemized receipt showing fee line.
Anya (People Ops): Got it — so submit one expense, itemize: Eurail full cost, line for hostel nights, line for service fee, lines for each e-scooter sub and label owner. Currency note?
Sam (Travel Ops): Yes attach the card exchange screenshot or let Expensify use auto-conversion. If any individual's share exceeds €100 require manager retro-approval — since this was unexpected, include manager's note in comments. Also add the declined-payment screenshot so finance can reconcile.
Expensify Bot: Expense draft created: 1865000000-group-offsite. Reminder: attach itemized receipts, decline screenshot, and set 'split among' field for each participant. Link: https://expensify.example/1865000000
Anya (People Ops): Thanks — I'll submit now and ping managers for quick approvals.
